#en: That I do. Found this place a few months back. Abandoned for years... Falling apart at the seams!
zh: 确实。几个月前发现了这地方。废弃多年……到处都在散架！

#en: This should at least be enough to even the odds against any Watchtower patrols that come our way.
zh: 这至少够我们在遇到瞭望塔巡逻队时扳回局面。

#en: Now, a ship needs a pilot. If you have an available crew member, you can assign the role to them.
zh: 现在，飞船需要飞行员。要是你有空闲的船员，可以把这个角色分配给他们。

#en: I've already done most of the prepwork. Installing this to the main board shouldn't be difficult.
zh: 准备工作我基本做完了。装到主板上应该不难。

#en: If you're curious, please, feel free to ask any questions you might have. I'll answer what I can.
zh: 如果你好奇，尽管提问。能答的我都答。

#en: You've already got this model type, but we can make it even more effective, if you're interested?
zh: 这个型号你已经有了，但如果你有兴趣，我们能让它更高效。

#en: Generates a destabilizing gravity wave, knocking down enemies and creating widespread disruption.
zh: 生成不稳定的重力波，击倒敌人并造成大范围混乱。

#en: Coordinates sent. Take a look if you want. But stay safe, all right? Watchtower aren't pushovers.
zh: 坐标已发送。想看就去看看。但注意安全，好吗？瞭望塔可不是软柿子。

#en: Can give it a shot. Question is, how daring are you feelin'? What kinda risk are you looking for?
zh: 可以试试。问题是你胆子有多大？想冒什么样的风险？

#en: Okay! Back to Stardock. New Gren should be happy to get his hands on the Control Node. Off we go!
zh: 好！回星坞。这个格伦应该很乐意拿到控制节点。我们走！

#en: Hah, yeah, thanks for letting me off the hook! Or at least...  I assume that was the sentiment...
zh: 哈，是啊，谢谢你放我一马！或者至少……我猜是这个意思……

#en: I'll Grav Shift when I'm near the ground. The displacement will probably send me a few miles off.
zh: 我接近地面时会重力位移。位移大概会把我甩出去几英里。

#en: Oh, thanks! Although, it's not really mine. I'll introduce you to the owner later. But for now...
zh: 哦，谢谢！不过严格说这不是我的。以后再介绍你认识主人。但现在……

#en: Ah, Harper! I owe you an apology, but if I wanted to rescue my friend, I had to leave the station.
zh: 啊，哈珀！我欠你一句道歉，但我要救朋友，就只能离开空间站。

#en: Still, I think Harper's a decent person. She seems to care about this place, and the people in it.
zh: 不过，我觉得哈珀是个好人。她似乎在乎这地方，和这里的人。

#en: Doesn't matter if you have Intel or not, all the Listening Post are already gone. You got 'em all!
zh: 你有没有情报都无所谓，所有监听哨都已经没了。你全端了！

#en: Hey, how about a store discount? Least I can do for someone who had to put up with living in Neon.
zh: 嘿，给你个商店折扣怎么样？对一个忍过霓虹城生活的人，这是我起码能做的。

#en: Hmm... Ecliptic could probably dig something up. Though, knowing them, it'll cost a small fortune.
zh: 嗯……黄道佣兵团大概能挖出点什么。不过照他们的做派，得花一大笔。

#en: Looks like you can still stand, mostly walk, and kinda talk. So! We're good to get going, I think.
zh: 看来你还能站、勉强能走、凑合能说话。那么！我看可以出发了。

#en: ...You know what? I like your way better! Drop something heavy on the mech, call it a day. Classy.
zh: ……你知道吗？我更喜欢你的办法！往机甲上扔个大家伙，收工。有格调。

#en: Good job finding that security card. You clearly put the work in. Gave this place a good perusing!
zh: 找到那张安保卡干得好。你明显下了功夫。把这地方翻了个遍！

#en: Huh. That's lucky! Means you should be able to walk, and in a straight line even! More or less....
zh: 哦。运气不错！说明你能走路，还能走直线！差不多吧……

#en: Huh. Y'know, since I bagged the last one, I think it's only fair to call this one yours. Good job.
zh: 哦。你知道，既然上一个算我的，那这个归你才算公平。干得好。

#en: The Fleet-Sync Control Node is waiting for us on Eridani III. I'll get in my ship and wait for ya.
zh: 舰队同步控制节点在波江座III等着我们。我上船等你。

#en: Gren can then install it into your ship, which will allow us to move on to building up your fleet!
zh: 然后格伦能把它装到你的飞船上，我们就能着手组建舰队了！

#en: I think you know what I'm talking about... I can see it in your eyes. There's something about you.
zh: 我想你知道我在说什么……我看得出你的眼神。你身上有些特别之处。

#en: The Intel Slate wiped itself. Inbuilt security measure! Most Watchtower tech has a "self-destruct".
zh: 情报数据板自我清除了。内置的安保措施！大多数瞭望塔技术都有「自毁」。

#en: What's Watchtower tryna poke their nose into, and why? That kind of intel could be worth something.
zh: 瞭望塔想插手什么，为什么？那种情报可能值点钱。

#en: Torin? Oh, that's a story! We first met here, on this very station. Both trying to lay claim to it.
zh: 托林？哦，那可说来话长！我们初次见面就在这儿，就在这座空间站。两人都想占它。

#en: It's grueling work, but there's something raw and real about it all that just seems to speak to me.
zh: 这活很累，但其中有种粗粝而真实的东西，仿佛在对我说话。

#en: One moment, and I'll attempt to extract the required data. Don't worry, this isn't my first time...
zh: 稍等，我试着提取所需数据。别担心，我不是第一次干这个……

#en: Executes a coordinated orbital bombardment, saturating a wide area with multiple explosive strikes.
zh: 执行协同轨道轰炸，用多次爆炸打击覆盖广阔区域。

#en: Mobilizes a military-grade combat drone. Armed and armored, it provides tactical support in battle.
zh: 部署一架军用级战斗无人机。配备武器与装甲，在战斗中提供战术支援。

#en: ...I trust Torin has explained how it all operates? Naturally, you'll need flares to call one down.
zh: ……我想托林已经解释过它怎么运作？当然，你需要信号弹来呼叫投放。

#en: Once I'm low enough, I'll do a Grav Shift. Displacement will scatter me a few miles away, at least.
zh: 我一降到足够低就做重力位移。位移至少会把我甩到几英里外。

#en: *sigh* Look, as long as you understand the risks, just--... Don't leave this for too long, alright?
zh: *叹气* 听着，只要你明白风险，就——……别把这事拖太久，好吗？

#en: I assume you also know of our capabilities, so it would be foolish to resist. Please, come quietly.
zh: 我想你也知道我们的实力，反抗是愚蠢的。请安静地跟我们走。

#en: Hm. Just give me a second here... I'm gonna see what information I can pull from this Intel Slate...
zh: 嗯。等我一下……我看看能从这块情报数据板里挖出什么……

#en: Well, we got a fleet! No reason not to head out right away! Guess I should get aboard my new ship...
zh: 好，我们有舰队了！没理由不马上出发！我该上我的新船了……

#en: Of course, it's only two ships. But in time, and with additional resources, we can grow that number.
zh: 当然，只有两艘船。但假以时日、有了更多资源，我们能扩大规模。

#en: Learning what Watchtower does to people like you, and Torin? That was something I wanted no part in.
zh: 得知瞭望塔对你和托林这样的人做的事？那是我绝不想参与的事。

#en: As for more personal details, you should go ask her yourself! I don't think she'd object to sharing.
zh: 至于更私密的细节，你自己去问她吧！我想她不会介意说。

#en: Well, let's see... There's me, Gren, and the occasional drifter. And I suppose now you as well! Hah.
zh: 嗯，我想想……有我、格伦，偶尔还有流浪者。现在大概还得算上你！哈。

#en: Without the hacking algorithm from your engineer, I doubt I'd have gotten anywhere with any of this.
zh: 没有你那位工程师的破解算法，我估计这些事一件也办不成。

#en: It seems you're a bit short on Computer Cores. You'll need more if you want me to proceed with this.
zh: 你的计算机核心好像不太够。想让我继续就得再多些。

#en: Fires a sustained orbital laser, delivering continuous, concentrated damage to a location or target.
zh: 发射持续的轨道激光，对一处地点或目标造成连续集中的伤害。

#en: It seemed the best way to get out of there. Hm. But it wasn't easy. None of it came naturally to me.
zh: 那似乎是离开那儿最好的办法。嗯。但并不容易。这些对我来说都不轻松。

#en: You're looking more "upright" than I'd expect. Guessing the Disruptor didn't get a clean hit on you.
zh: 你比我想的要「站得直」。我猜干扰器没正面命中你。

#en: Perhaps I should have mentioned this sooner, this is an old Watchtower facility we're breaking into.
zh: 也许我该早点说，我们要闯的是一座旧的瞭望塔设施。

#en: I knew Watchtower would be searching for you. And I also knew they'd probably find you before I did.
zh: 我知道瞭望塔会找你。我也知道他们大概会比我更早找到你。

#en: I think I first got their attention, uh... after I dealt with a particularly nasty group of pirates.
zh: 我想我第一次引起他们注意，呃……是在我收拾掉一伙特别凶的海盗之后。

#en: Sooner or later, you're gonna have to deal with them. When you're ready to do that, come talk to me.
zh: 迟早你得跟他们了断。等你准备好，来找我谈。

#en: I understand, and I'll even ignore the attitude. Getting ambushed is enough to make anyone tetchy...
zh: 我理解，我甚至可以不计较你的态度。被伏击谁都会烦躁……

#en: Oh, you just can't stay out of trouble, can you? And here I thought you'd learn after the last time.
zh: 哦，你就是不惹麻烦不开心，是吧？我还以为上次之后你会学乖。

#en: Gren is ex-Watchtower. He's defected, no longer with them! Now he's as much their enemy as you or me.
zh: 格伦是前瞭望塔成员。他叛逃了，不再属于他们！现在他和你我一样是他们的敌人。

#en: Gren maybe isn't what you'll be expecting... But you don't need to worry about him! He's on our side.
zh: 格伦也许和你预想的不一样……但你不必担心他！他在我们这边。

#en: Huh. We've got the previous model of this one. I can extract and upgrade if that's what you're after?
zh: 哦。这个我们有上一代型号。如果你想要，我可以提取并升级？

#en: Deploys a fortified turret armed with a high-powered laser, offering superior offensive capabilities.
zh: 部署一座配备高能激光的强化炮塔，提供更强的进攻能力。

#en: Some of the corps I know of include, uh.. GalBank, Ryujin Industries, SolarLink, Slayton Aerospace...
zh: 我知道的企业有些，呃……盖尔银行、龙神集团、太阳联、斯莱顿航宇……

#en: My amps can also help me suppress the need for sleep. I can work for four days straight if necessary.
zh: 我的增幅还能帮我压制睡意。必要时我能连干四天。

#en: Good luck! And just a reminder, when I Grav Shift from my ship, there's no telling where I'll end up.
zh: 祝你好运！再提醒一句，我从飞船重力位移后，落点在哪儿说不准。

#en: I'm glad you think so! But unfortunately, for now, that's where the good news ends. Let me explain...
zh: 很高兴你这么想！但遗憾的是，好消息到此为止。我解释一下……

#en: It's worth a shot! If you can bring me more of those Slates, I can likely pull more locations for you.
zh: 值得一试！你要是能多带些数据板来，我大概能给你挖出更多位置。

#en: It could be something as innocuous as... planet survey records! Although, that would be anticlimactic.
zh: 也许是像……行星勘测记录这种平淡的东西！不过，那就太没劲了。

#en: Refines awareness of energy dynamics. Providing a noticeable damage increase to a pilot's laser usage.
zh: 精化对能量动态的感知。明显提升飞行员使用激光的伤害。

#en: Hah, feel guilty admitting that. 'Cause... turns out, he's actually a nice guy! Just a bit outlandish.
zh: 哈，承认这点我还挺愧疚。因为……结果他其实是个好人！只是有点古怪。

#en: As always, the Fleet-Sync Control Node's at Eridani III. I'll be waiting in my ship when you're ready.
zh: 跟往常一样，舰队同步控制节点在波江座III。你准备好时我在飞船里等。

#en: Fine. But the sooner we leave, the better. I want to be long gone if and when Watchtower show up here.
zh: 行。但越早走越好。万一瞭望塔来这儿，我可想早就走远了。

#en: The Listening Posts -- Watchtower use them to track people... But, only certain types of people. Huh...
zh: 监听哨——瞭望塔用它们追踪人……但只是某些类型的人。哦……

#en: I know, I know... And I'm sorry. But I left the station unattended for good reason! This person here...
zh: 我知道，我知道……我很抱歉。但我让空间站无人看守是有正当理由的！这个人……

#en: This Amp fine-tunes focus under pressure, allowing a pilot to predict ballistic timing more accurately.
zh: 这个增幅能微调压力下的专注力，让飞行员更准确地预判弹道时机。

#en: Ah! It's done. I've managed to pull the data. Although, the Computer Core seems to have wiped itself...
zh: 啊！完成了。我成功提取了数据。不过，那计算机核心似乎自我清除了……

#en: So, the next time you have spare cores, you'll need to decide what type of data you'd rather I extract.
zh: 所以下次你有富余的核心时，得决定想让我提取哪类数据。

#en: This is usually accompanied by the purging of memories. Not all memories, I remember most prior things.
zh: 这一般伴随着记忆的清除。不是所有记忆，大部分往事我都记得。

#en: Also, a warning. This technology is illegal, and will be treated as contraband. So prepare accordingly.
zh: 还有，一句警告。这技术是非法的，会被当作违禁品。所以你做好准备。

#en: A fresh set of eyes -- that knew how to hack into complex computer systems. Someone like my old friend.
zh: 一双新眼睛——精通入侵复杂电脑系统。就像我的一个老朋友。

#en: Once I'm close enough to the ground, I'll Grav Shift. Displacement will likely put me a few miles away.
zh: 我一接近地面就会重力位移。位移很可能让我落在几英里外。

#en: As soon as you took that first blast, I'd be right there to give Watchtower something else to shoot at!
zh: 你一挨第一发，我就会立刻出现，给瞭望塔点别的东西打！

#en: Ah, yep! My name's Torin, alright! That's about as much as I got from those noises you managed to make.
zh: 啊，对！我叫托林，没错！你挤出的那些声音，我也就听出这些。

#en: Although, since he ditched Watchtower, their codes have changed. Means his old tricks don't always work.
zh: 不过，自从他脱离瞭望塔，他们的密码就换了。所以他的老招数不总管用。

#en: It's something Gren cooked up. A program to slip past Watchtower's decryption, dig around in their data.
zh: 那是格伦搞出来的东西。一个能绕过瞭望塔解密、在他们数据里翻找的程序。

#en: We only passed by the system, but as best we could tell, the Listening Post was somewhere on Altair III.
zh: 我们只是路过那个星系，但据我们判断，监听哨在牵牛III的某处。

#en: Before we forget, should also hand over the Watchtower components to Gren. I mean, we're already here...
zh: 趁没忘，也该把瞭望塔部件交给格伦。毕竟我们都到这儿了……

#en: I was about to suggest you assign a pilot, but I see you've already figured out how to do that yourself.
zh: 我正要建议你分配飞行员，但看来你已经自己搞明白了。

#en: Oooh... I see. Hm. Then, I guess you had a good excuse to not be here. You're off the hook. This time...
zh: 哦……我明白了。嗯。那你算是有了不在此处的正当理由。这次就放过你……

#en: Watchtower was on the verge of grabbing 'em. If I hadn't left the station, I might've lost them forever.
zh: 瞭望塔眼看就要抓到他们。我要是没离开空间站，可能就永远失去他们了。

#en: The Field Surgeons are a healthcare corp. We specialize in emergency medical care, wherever it's needed.
zh: 战地医师是一家医疗企业。我们专做急救医疗，哪里有需要就去哪里。

#en: This Amp hones spatial awareness. Letting someone calculate missile trajectories with uncanny precision.
zh: 这个增幅能磨练空间感知。让人以惊人的精度计算导弹弹道。

#en: I may also be able to fabricate more for you. Be sure you check my personal stockpile from time to time.
zh: 我或许还能为你制造更多。记得时不时看看我的私人库存。

#en: Let's make the adjustments you need. But remember, if you bring me components, I can build you Skydrops.
zh: 我们来做你需要的调整。但记住，你带部件来，我就能给你造空投。

#en: Trade Authority opened a branch here. Not surprising, considering how many people are passing through...
zh: 贸易管理局在这儿开了分部。考虑到来往的人流量，不意外……

#en: Chart a course to the Eridani system. Planet's name is Eridani III. Make orbit and I'll be right behind.
zh: 设定前往波江座星系的航线。行星叫波江座III。入轨，我随后就到。

#en: But right now, we've got a Control Node to salvage! I'll be waiting for you in the black! Don't be long!
zh: 但现在，我们有个控制节点要打捞！我在太空里等你！别太久！

#en: As for any "sensitive information", whatever it might be, chances are Watchtower already knows about it.
zh: 至于什么「敏感信息」，不管是什么，瞭望塔多半早就知道了。

#en: Why indeed. What makes you so special...? What sets YOU apart from almost everyone else in the universe?
zh: 确实为什么。你凭什么特别……？你凭什么和宇宙里几乎所有人都不一样？

#en: Getting saved by me is starting to look like your favorite pastime. Might I suggest a change in hobbies?
zh: 被我救似乎快成了你最爱的消遣。要不要考虑换个爱好？

#en: Far as I know, yeah. I don't know if it ever explodes, but data definitely wipes itself if tampered with.
zh: 据我所知是这样。我不知道它会不会炸，但被动过手脚数据肯定会自清。

#en: Now? Now I do my own thing! No one holdin' me down, no one trying to pull my strings. Suits me just fine.
zh: 现在？现在我自己做主！没人压着我，没人牵着我走。我挺满意。

#en: In theory, I could... "upgrade" these things. But I'd need specialized components. Watchtower Components.
zh: 理论上，我可以……「升级」这些东西。但我需要专门的部件。瞭望塔部件。

#en: ...What? Why not?! They're great! Did I not demonstrate it right or something?! C'mon, let's install one!
zh: ……什么？为什么不要？！它们很棒啊！难道我没演示好吗？！来吧，装一个！

#en: Not thrilled about it, but -- you did do it for the right reasons. Your friend's safe, so I'll let it go.
zh: 我不太高兴，但——你的出发点是对的。你朋友安全，那就算了。

#en: They were almost a permanent guest of Watchtower. Thankfully though, I was there to save their sorry ass!
zh: 他们差点就成了瞭望塔的永久客人。幸好我在场，救了他们那可怜的屁股！

#en: He was very almost a permanent guest of Watchtower. Thankfully though, I was there to save his sorry ass!
zh: 他差一点就成了瞭望塔的永久客人。幸好我在场，救了他那可怜的屁股！

#en: It took some time, but I think I've finally cracked the secret to fabricating Watchtower-spec components.
zh: 花了些时间，但我想我终于破解了制造瞭望塔规格部件的秘密。

#en: Just sent the coordinates. Gonna trust you to do things right. No starting fights you can't finish, okay?
zh: 坐标刚发过去。我信你能办妥当。别挑起打不赢的架，好吗？

#en: Remember, the mech's going to pop out once we blast a hole in the facility. Me and my ship will be ready.
zh: 记住，我们一炸开设施，机甲就会冒出来。我和我的飞船会准备好。

#en: We'll have Watchtower reinforcements inbound again, so I'll go leave a trail to lead them away from here.
zh: 瞭望塔的增援又要来了，我去留点痕迹把他们引开。

#en: 'Cause I'm thinking, if we start shutting more of them down, Watchtower won't be able to track us as much!
zh: 因为我在想，要是我们多端掉几个，瞭望塔就没办法那么频繁追踪我们了！

#en: Heh. It worked! Quite a lot of data... I'm just skimming here, but... yeah, this clears up a few things...
zh: 嘿。成功了！数据不少……我只是粗略看看，但……对，这澄清了几件事……

#en: Felt right at the time, but didn't care much for all the regulations. Just wanted to do what needed doin'.
zh: 当时觉得对，但我受不了那些规章。只想把该做的事做了。

#en: Yeah, yeah! I know... I wrecked it. As well as the Skydrop system you installed. I do feel bad about it...
zh: 是啊，是啊！我知道……我把它弄毁了。还有你装的空投系统。我确实挺过意不去……

#en: Aha! Got it right here. Was exactly where you said we'd find it. Was a smooth recovery, for the most part!
zh: 啊哈！就在这儿。跟你说的地方一模一样。大体上，这次回收很顺利！

#en: If I hadn't left, Watchtower would have grabbed 'em! So you see, it really was a matter of life and death!
zh: 我要是没走，瞭望塔就把他们抓走了！所以你看，这真是生死攸关的事！

#en: She was very almost a permanent guest of Watchtower. Thankfully though, I was there to save her sorry ass!
zh: 她差一点就成了瞭望塔的永久客人。幸好我在场，救了她那可怜的屁股！

#en: Extraction complete! Your Amp's blueprint is ready, and I can start building this model whenever you like.
zh: 提取完成！你的增幅图纸好了，你随时想造这个型号我都能开工。

#en: Back when I was still with Watchtower, a ship I was serving on received an order to intercept a "Deviant".
zh: 我还在瞭望塔时，我服役的一艘船接到命令去拦截一个「异常体」。

#en: I am pleased to report a complete success! I recovered enough data to allow creation -- of a mech Skydrop.
zh: 很高兴报告，彻底成功！我提取到足够的数据，可以制造——机甲空投。

#en: So if some inspector ever decides to drop by, and I offer you an ice cream cone, just play along. Alright?
zh: 所以要是哪天有检查员上门，我递给你一个冰淇淋筒，你就配合一下。好吗？

#en: If you're interested, go to the new infirmary and talk to Dr. Laine. She can fill you in on the specifics.
zh: 如果你有兴趣，去新医务室找莱恩医生。她能告诉你具体细节。

#en: Sending the data to your nav. Just don't do anything reckless! No shame in avoiding a fight you can't win.
zh: 把数据发到你导航了。别做鲁莽的事！避开打不赢的架不丢人。

#en: If Watchtower captures you, it's not just your freedom they take. They steal from you your full potential.
zh: 瞭望塔抓走你，夺走的不只是自由。他们还会夺走你全部的潜力。

#en: Eugh... you're not the only one... First time I got hit -- the next thing I saw was my lunch in reverse...
zh: 呃……不止你一个……我第一次挨了一下——接着就看见午饭倒着出来……

#en: Although... Are you sure they're what we're looking for? I'm not getting any readings from them anymore...
zh: 不过……你确定那是我们要找的吗？我已经收不到它们的任何读数了……

#en: It would be more accurate to say that I "fabricate" them. To do this, I use salvaged Watchtower components.
zh: 更准确地说是我「制造」它们。为此我用打捞来的瞭望塔部件。

#en: Watchtower was closing in fast on 'em, so sticking around here wasn't an option. Not if I wanted them safe.
zh: 瞭望塔正快速逼近他们，所以我不能留在这儿。想让他们安全就不能。

#en: Harper! You know what, you're absolutely right. I should've stayed, or at least let you know I was leaving.
zh: 哈珀！你知道，你完全说得对。我该留下，或者至少告诉你我要走。

#en: My parents ran a small clinic there, actually. They're the ones who first inspired me to get into medicine.
zh: 其实我父母在那儿开了家小诊所。是他们最早启发我从医。

#en: Well, aren't you a charmer! Careful now, or you may end up with more than just my professional attention...
zh: 哟，你可真会说话！当心点，不然你得到的不只是我的专业关照……

#en: Resulting in blueprints for an Amp that's... well, this might be the most advanced Cyberamp I've ever seen!
zh: 产出的增幅图纸……嗯，这可能是我见过最先进的赛博增幅！

#en: Fires a warhead that ignites the impact zone, creating a firestorm that incinerates anything caught within.
zh: 发射一枚弹头点燃落点区域，制造火风暴，焚毁范围内的一切。

#en: And, weirdly enough, he's also a great cook! What the crap? Did not expect that. So, no, I'm not concerned.
zh: 而且奇怪的是，他做菜还很棒！搞什么鬼？真没想到。所以，不，我不担心。

#en: When I'm low enough, I'll use the Grav Shift to escape. I'll probably end up miles away from your position.
zh: 我一降到足够低就用重力位移脱身。很可能落在离你几英里外。

#en: Second, that ship needs to be loaded with whatever it is you require. Ship can't drop what it doesn't have.
zh: 其次，那艘船得装载你需要的东西。船投不了它没有的东西。

#en: I guess you could say I'm a... traveler! Yeah, I travel the stars! Here n' there, and sometimes back again.
zh: 你可以说我是个……旅行者！对，我在星海间旅行！这儿那儿，有时还回头。

#en: These guys, they will come for you again. And right now, there's precious little you could do to stop them.
zh: 这些人还会再来找你。而眼下，你几乎无力阻止他们。

#en: But as soon as I picked up your signal, I knew we had pulled it off! I wasn't even that far away, actually.
zh: 但我一收到你的信号，就知道我们成功了！其实我当时并不算远。

#en: Well, that's something! We can always go take that one down. And hey! Maybe we'll recover more Intel Slates!
zh: 那也不错！我们随时能去端掉那个。而且嘿！说不定还能回收更多情报数据板！

#en: We're not quite done yet. You've still got those Watchtower components to hand over. Go on! Gren won't mind.
zh: 还没完呢。你还有那些瞭望塔部件要交。去吧！格伦不会介意。

#en: The brain syncs perfectly with laser recharge cycles, thanks to this Amp. The result? Faster recharge times.
zh: 靠这个增幅，大脑与激光充能周期完美同步。结果？充能更快。

#en: And by the time I found it, it was just a gutted shell! Forgotten, left to rot out in the middle of nowhere.
zh: 等我找到时，它已经只剩个空壳！被遗忘，扔在荒僻之地慢慢锈掉。

#en: To start, it was 'cause Torin seemed to care about you. And, well, since he's a pal, I figured I'd pitch in.
zh: 一开始，是因为托林似乎在乎你。而且，既然他是哥们，我想我也该出份力。

#en: From that core, we pulled data for Watchtower-spec neuroamps. Only basic models, mind you, but still useful.
zh: 我们从那个核心里提取到了瞭望塔规格神经增幅器的数据。只是基础型号，不过还是有用。

#en: Tidied up a bit. With so many visitors coming and going, figured Stardock could use a bit of extra polish...
zh: 稍微收拾了一下。来往的人这么多，我想星坞该更体面些……

#en: So, don't waste time waiting for me! Get into the facility and retrieve the Control Node. Let's get it done!
zh: 所以别浪费时间等我！进设施去取控制节点。把它办了！

#en: Well, why didn't you say so sooner?! I had no idea I was in the presence of such esteemed company! *chuckle*
zh: 你干吗不早说？！没想到我竟有幸与如此尊贵的人物同处一室！*轻笑*

#en: We appreciate it, Gren! Really! But, are you sure there's nothing else? Not to sound ungrateful, it's just...
zh: 我们很感激，格伦！真的！但，你确定没别的了？不是不领情，只是……

#en: They're one of the current leaders in cybernetic research. Or, at least they were when I was still with them.
zh: 他们是当前赛博格研究的领先者之一。或者至少我还在他们那儿时是。
